rationale: The stock gapped up ~6.6% on positive earnings news but has since reversed sharply, trading near the session low at 4.9% of today's range with price well below VWAP ($11.19) and the 9-EMA ($11.23), suggesting aggressive selling pressure overwhelming the earnings catalyst. The last five 1-minute candles show a consistent downtrend with the most recent candle closing at the session low ($10.68), but the wide bid-ask spread of 121 bps and the proximity to the low make both a short (risk of snap-back bounce) and a long (momentum clearly down) unattractive risk/reward setups at this moment.
